name: dev-kit
description: Complete Claude agentic dev-kit: 11 specialized subagents, 8 skills, 4 commands, 6 hook scripts, and 6 MCP integrations for the full software development lifecycle.

context7_api_key.title: Context7 API key
context7_api_key.description: Get a free key at https://context7.com/dashboard for higher rate limits. Leave blank to use the free tier.

enable_autoformat.title: Auto-format files after edits
enable_autoformat.description: Run prettier/black/gofmt/rustfmt after Claude writes or edits a file (if installed). Override per-session with DEVKIT_DISABLE_AUTOFORMAT=1.

enable_bash_guard.title: Block destructive bash commands
enable_bash_guard.description: Block rm -rf, force-pushes to protected branches, chmod 777, and similar. Also gates the write guard. Override per-session with DEVKIT_DISABLE_BASH_GUARD=1.

enable_session_context.title: Inject project context on session start
enable_session_context.description: On SessionStart, inject git branch, recent commits, uncommitted changes, open TODOs, and recent decisions. Override per-session with DEVKIT_DISABLE_SESSION_CONTEXT=1.

openviking_base_url.title: OpenViking server URL
openviking_base_url.description: Base URL of your OpenViking server, e.g. https://openviking.example.com. Leave blank to skip memory setup.

openviking_api_key.title: OpenViking API key
openviking_api_key.description: API key for your OpenViking server.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key
brave_api_key.description: Optional. Enables web search for the researcher agent. Get a free key at brave.com/search/api.

memory_path.title: Local memory store path
memory_path.description: Path for the local knowledge graph memory store. Defaults to ~/.claude/dev-kit-memory.

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.description: Use when starting a non-trivial task from scratch or when agents return blocked/partial and recovery routing is needed.

agents.name: researcher
agents.description: Use at the start of any task to map affected code and gather context before planning.

agents.name: planner
agents.description: Use after research to decompose a task into a step list before implementation.

agents.name: reverse-reasoner
agents.description: Use after the planner to validate a plan before implementation begins.

agents.name: implementer
agents.description: Use after the plan is validated to write the code changes.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Use after the implementer finishes to review the diff before accepting the work.

agents.name: test-runner
agents.description: Use after the implementer or reviewer to run the test suite and report results.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.description: Use after the general reviewer on changes touching auth, input handling, external APIs, file I/O, or infrastructure.

agents.name: debugger
agents.description: Use when there is a bug to diagnose, a test is failing and the cause is unclear, or a runtime error needs reproducing.

agents.name: ci-triager
agents.description: Use when a CI run on a PR or branch has failed and you need a quick diagnosis.

agents.name: memory-curator
agents.description: Use at session end when significant decisions were made or when memory files are growing stale.

skills.name: project-bootstrap
skills.description: Bootstrap a new project CLAUDE.md. Trigger: no CLAUDE.md in the project root yet.

skills.name: debug-playbook
skills.description: Structured debugging workflow. Trigger: there is a bug to fix.

skills.name: pr-checklist
skills.description: Pre-merge checklist. Trigger: ready to submit a PR.

skills.name: security-review
skills.description: Security audit of changes. Trigger: security check requested or changes touch sensitive areas.

skills.name: dependency-audit
skills.description: Dependency vulnerability scan. Trigger: new deps added or scheduled audit.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.description: Production rollback guide. Trigger: something broke after a deploy.

skills.name: deploy-check
skills.description: Pre-deploy readiness check. Trigger: about to deploy.

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: Project state-of-the-union for newcomers. Trigger: new to the project or returning after a break.

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Initialize CLAUDE.md for a new project

commands.name: security-check
commands.description: Run a security audit on the current diff

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Re-run bootstrap in refresh mode to update a stale CLAUDE.md

mcpServers.name: serena
mcpServers.description: Code intelligence — symbol lookup, find-references, LSP-level analysis

mcpServers.name: brave-search
mcpServers.description: Web search for researcher agent (optional, needs BRAVE_API_KEY)

mcpServers.name: memory
mcpServers.description: Local knowledge graph memory store (optional, runs locally)
